positions.name: WinterRotaHoursAndSaturdayStaffing
positions.frame: Given where borrowers actually turn up, how should the tool library's winter opening hours and shift staffing be set?
positions.why: Both statements address the same winter rota question. src-1 gives the opening pattern (Saturdays only) and the demand evidence behind it (four weekday-evening borrowers in six weeks). src-2 gives the staffing that follows for the Saturday shift: a second volunteer on returns. Read together, the evidence, the hours and the staffing sit under one frame. The dimensional reads agree that src-1 is a past-anchored, factual claim and src-2 is a forward-looking directive. That makes the pair an evidence-then-consequence sequence, not two separate frames. No tension is held within the set.
